help.title: How to use
help.intro: Inventory helps you remember where your things are: take a photo, say where you put it, and find it later in seconds.

approval.title: Account approval
points: After sign-up, the administrator must approve your account.
Until then, after signing in you only see “Your account is awaiting approval” and a Sign out button.
Once approved, refresh the page or sign in again.

install.title: Install on your phone
points: iPhone: open the site in Safari → Share → “Add to Home Screen”.
Android: open the site in Chrome → ⋮ → “Install app”.
The app then opens from its icon like any other.

places.title: Places
points: Places nest inside each other: house → room → closet → shelf, as deep as you need.
Add places in “Places” or by voice while adding an item.
Moved a closet? Move it in the app — the items inside move with it.

here.title: “I'm here” mode
points: Pick a place once, e.g. “Country house → Garage → Rack”.
Every new item goes there: photograph things in a row without choosing a place each time.
The current place is shown in the header, where you can change or clear it.

add.title: Add an item
points: Tap the camera at the bottom and take a photo.
AI fills in the name, description and category.
Say where you put it and what it is: “it's dad's old drill, put it in the garage on the rack”.
Check the suggestions and tap “Save”.

find.title: Find an item
points: Plain search: type a word — “drill”.
Smart search: tap the mic and ask “where is my drill?” — AI adds similar words and understands places.
Results show photos and the full place path.

views.title: Gallery and table
points: In “Items”, switch between a photo gallery and a compact table.
Filter by category and by place — including all nested places.

categories.title: Categories
points: A standard set is ready: tools, kitchen, clothing and more.
In “Settings” you can rename and delete categories or add your own.

tips.title: Tips
points: Photograph items close up on a light background — AI recognizes them better.
Say the full place path: “at the country house, in the garage, on the rack”.
Allow the microphone and camera when the browser asks.
No mic at hand? Everything works with typed text too.
